Messages.Author: pgh...@city-net.com
Messages.Body:
These questions came up during our most recent play day.

Trap

If a vampire plays a trap card and the opposing vampire uses a senger
dagger and the vampire gets aggro damage does it go into torpor
immediately or is the Trap still played out? What if the vampire is Igo
and he get two points of agro damage. Does he die and the trap end or does
he still inflict damage until the Trap is over?

Master Phase

If Anson is ready you get two Master Phases. What happens then if you call
the Rumors of Ghenna vote and it passes. Do you then get three master
phases? What if another Rumors is passed. Do you get four Master Phases
and so on?

This is the first time in over three months that we had to stop our game
and argue about something. We came to a compromise but would like further
input.

Tanks.

Randy Sams

Messages.Author: REF
Messages.Body:
pgh...@city-net.com wrote:

>These questions came up during our most recent play day.

>Trap

>If a vampire plays a trap card and the opposing vampire uses a senger
>dagger and the vampire gets aggro damage does it go into torpor
>immediately or is the Trap still played out? What if the vampire is Igo
>and he get two points of agro damage. Does he die and the trap end or does
>he still inflict damage until the Trap is over?

Well the Trap simply gives a continuing source of presses so if a
press to end or any effect that ends combat such as strikes like
Majesty or going to Torpor or being burned happen then the fight is
over.
Along those lines the Undying Persistence fortitude card gives 1 press
and prevents the vampire going to torpor until the fight is over.
So if the vampire is burned instead of simply sent to Torpor or if
some card is played to end combat and/ or no presses are made to
continue then the fight is also over.

>Master Phase

>If Anson is ready you get two Master Phases. What happens then if you call
>the Rumors of Ghenna vote and it passes. Do you then get three master
>phases? What if another Rumors is passed. Do you get four Master Phases
>and so on?

All of these get you 2 action phases not additional ones. So your
resetting the base not adding to it.
Rory

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
<pgh...@city-net.com> wrote:
>If a vampire plays a trap card and the opposing vampire uses a senger
>dagger and the vampire gets aggro damage does it go into torpor
>immediately or is the Trap still played out? What if the vampire is Igo
>and he get two points of agro damage. Does he die and the trap end or does
>he still inflict damage until the Trap is over?

Trap just provides presses, and has no particular ability to sustain
combat. Sending a vampire into torpor ends the combat, Trap notwithstanding.
Similarly, if one of the minions is burned, the combat is over.

>If Anson is ready you get two Master Phases. What happens then if you call
>the Rumors of Ghenna vote and it passes. Do you then get three master
>phases? What if another Rumors is passed. Do you get four Master Phases
>and so on?

Each of these effects sets your number of master phase actions to two,
so they are redundant, not cumulative.
